/* Ręczne sprawdzanie nowych wpisów bez Workera: publiczne API WordPress.com + fallback. */
(function(){
'use strict';
var d=document,b=d.getElementById('ncheck');if(!b)return;
var POST_KEY='inewspost5',CHECK_KEY='inewschk5',CARD_KEY='ilatestpost6';
function say(msg){var t=d.getElementById('iaToast');if(!t)return;t.textContent=msg;t.classList.add('on');setTimeout(function(){t.classList.remove('on')},3600)}
function stamp(ts,title){var e=d.getElementById('nplast');if(!e)return;var x=new Date(ts),hh=String(x.getHours()).padStart(2,'0')+':'+String(x.getMinutes()).padStart(2,'0');e.textContent='Ostatnie ręczne sprawdzenie: dziś '+hh+(title?' • '+title:'')}
function normalise(j){
 var p=null;
 if(j&&j.posts&&j.posts.length){p=j.posts[0];return{id:String(p.ID||''),link:p.URL||'',title:String(p.title||'Najnowszy wpis'),date:p.date||''}}
 if(j&&Array.isArray(j)&&j.length){p=j[0];return{id:String(p.id||''),link:p.link||'',title:String(p.title&&p.title.rendered?p.title.rendered:(p.title||'Najnowszy wpis')),date:p.date||''}}
 return null;
}
function decodeHtml(x){var ta=d.createElement('textarea');ta.innerHTML=x||'';return ta.value}
function done(p){
 if(!p||!p.id){fail();return}
 var now=Date.now(),old='';try{old=localStorage.getItem(POST_KEY)||''}catch(_){ }
 p.title=decodeHtml(p.title);
 try{localStorage.setItem(POST_KEY,p.id);localStorage.setItem(CHECK_KEY,String(now));localStorage.setItem(CARD_KEY,JSON.stringify({id:p.id,link:p.link,title:p.title,date:p.date,t:now}))}catch(_){ }
 stamp(now,p.title.length>54?p.title.slice(0,51)+'…':p.title);
 if(old&&old!==p.id)say('🔔 Jest nowy wpis: '+p.title);
 else if(!old)say('✓ Sprawdzono. Zapamiętałem najnowszy wpis.');
 else say('✓ Brak nowych wpisów.');
 b.disabled=false;b.textContent='Sprawdź nowości';
}
function xhr(url,ok,bad){try{var x=new XMLHttpRequest;x.open('GET',url,true);x.timeout=9000;x.setRequestHeader('Accept','application/json');x.onload=function(){if(x.status>=200&&x.status<300){try{ok(JSON.parse(x.responseText))}catch(e){bad()}}else bad()};x.onerror=x.ontimeout=bad;x.send()}catch(e){bad()}}
function jsonp(){
 var cb='__ilNews_'+Date.now(),sc=d.createElement('script'),finished=false;
 function clean(){try{delete window[cb]}catch(_){window[cb]=void 0}if(sc.parentNode)sc.parentNode.removeChild(sc)}
 window[cb]=function(j){if(finished)return;finished=true;clean();done(normalise(j))};
 sc.onerror=function(){if(finished)return;finished=true;clean();fail()};
 sc.src='https://public-api.wordpress.com/rest/v1/sites/ispinalokalnie.wordpress.com/posts/?number=1&fields=ID,URL,title,date&callback='+encodeURIComponent(cb)+'&_='+(Date.now());
 d.head.appendChild(sc);setTimeout(function(){if(!finished){finished=true;clean();fail()}},10000);
}
function fallback(){var u='https://ispinalokalnie.wordpress.com/wp-json/wp/v2/posts?per_page=1&_fields=id,link,title,date&_='+(Date.now());xhr(u,function(j){done(normalise(j))},jsonp)}
function fail(){say('Nie udało się sprawdzić wpisów. Spróbuj ponownie.');b.disabled=false;b.textContent='Sprawdź nowości'}
b.onclick=function(){
 if(!navigator.onLine){say('Nie mam teraz połączenia z internetem.');return}
 b.disabled=true;b.textContent='Sprawdzam…';
 var u='https://public-api.wordpress.com/rest/v1/sites/ispinalokalnie.wordpress.com/posts/?number=1&fields=ID,URL,title,date&_='+(Date.now());
 xhr(u,function(j){done(normalise(j))},fallback);
};
})();

}catch(e){}})();

/* Karta dnia 1.81.14 — independent offline module */
(function(){try{
var module={exports:{}},exports=module.exports;
/*
 (c) 2011-2015, Vladimir Agafonkin
 SunCalc is a JavaScript library for calculating sun/moon position and light phases.
 https://github.com/mourner/suncalc
*/

(function () { 'use strict';

// shortcuts for easier to read formulas

var PI   = Math.PI,
    sin  = Math.sin,
    cos  = Math.cos,
    tan  = Math.tan,
    asin = Math.asin,
    atan = Math.atan2,
    acos = Math.acos,
    rad  = PI / 180;

// sun calculations are based on http://aa.quae.nl/en/reken/zonpositie.html formulas


// date/time constants and conversions

var dayMs = 1000 * 60 * 60 * 24,
    J1970 = 2440588,
    J2000 = 2451545;

function toJulian(date) { return date.valueOf() / dayMs - 0.5 + J1970; }
function fromJulian(j)  { return new Date((j + 0.5 - J1970) * dayMs); }
function toDays(date)   { return toJulian(date) - J2000; }


// general calculations for position

var e = rad * 23.4397; // obliquity of the Earth

function rightAscension(l, b) { return atan(sin(l) * cos(e) - tan(b) * sin(e), cos(l)); }
function declination(l, b)    { return asin(sin(b) * cos(e) + cos(b) * sin(e) * sin(l)); }

function azimuth(H, phi, dec)  { return atan(sin(H), cos(H) * sin(phi) - tan(dec) * cos(phi)); }
function altitude(H, phi, dec) { return asin(sin(phi) * sin(dec) + cos(phi) * cos(dec) * cos(H)); }

function siderealTime(d, lw) { return rad * (280.16 + 360.9856235 * d) - lw; }

function astroRefraction(h) {
    if (h < 0) // the following formula works for positive altitudes only.
        h = 0; // if h = -0.08901179 a div/0 would occur.

    // formula 16.4 of "Astronomical Algorithms" 2nd edition by Jean Meeus (Willmann-Bell, Richmond) 1998.
    // 1.02 / tan(h + 10.26 / (h + 5.10)) h in degrees, result in arc minutes -> converted to rad:
    return 0.0002967 / Math.tan(h + 0.00312536 / (h + 0.08901179));
}

// general sun calculations

function solarMeanAnomaly(d) { return rad * (357.5291 + 0.98560028 * d); }

function eclipticLongitude(M) {

    var C = rad * (1.9148 * sin(M) + 0.02 * sin(2 * M) + 0.0003 * sin(3 * M)), // equation of center
        P = rad * 102.9372; // perihelion of the Earth

    return M + C + P + PI;
}

function sunCoords(d) {

    var M = solarMeanAnomaly(d),
        L = eclipticLongitude(M);

    return {
        dec: declination(L, 0),
        ra: rightAscension(L, 0)
    };
}


var SunCalc = {};


// calculates sun position for a given date and latitude/longitude

SunCalc.getPosition = function (date, lat, lng) {

    var lw  = rad * -lng,
        phi = rad * lat,
        d   = toDays(date),

        c  = sunCoords(d),
        H  = siderealTime(d, lw) - c.ra;

    return {
        azimuth: azimuth(H, phi, c.dec),
        altitude: altitude(H, phi, c.dec)
    };
};


// sun times configuration (angle, morning name, evening name)

var times = SunCalc.times = [
    [-0.833, 'sunrise',       'sunset'      ],
    [  -0.3, 'sunriseEnd',    'sunsetStart' ],
    [    -6, 'dawn',          'dusk'        ],
    [   -12, 'nauticalDawn',  'nauticalDusk'],
    [   -18, 'nightEnd',      'night'       ],
    [     6, 'goldenHourEnd', 'goldenHour'  ]
];

// adds a custom time to the times config

SunCalc.addTime = function (angle, riseName, setName) {
    times.push([angle, riseName, setName]);
};


// calculations for sun times

var J0 = 0.0009;

function julianCycle(d, lw) { return Math.round(d - J0 - lw / (2 * PI)); }

function approxTransit(Ht, lw, n) { return J0 + (Ht + lw) / (2 * PI) + n; }
function solarTransitJ(ds, M, L)  { return J2000 + ds + 0.0053 * sin(M) - 0.0069 * sin(2 * L); }

function hourAngle(h, phi, d) { return acos((sin(h) - sin(phi) * sin(d)) / (cos(phi) * cos(d))); }
function observerAngle(height) { return -2.076 * Math.sqrt(height) / 60; }

// returns set time for the given sun altitude
function getSetJ(h, lw, phi, dec, n, M, L) {

    var w = hourAngle(h, phi, dec),
        a = approxTransit(w, lw, n);
    return solarTransitJ(a, M, L);
}


// calculates sun times for a given date, latitude/longitude, and, optionally,
// the observer height (in meters) relative to the horizon

SunCalc.getTimes = function (date, lat, lng, height) {

    height = height || 0;

    var lw = rad * -lng,
        phi = rad * lat,

        dh = observerAngle(height),

        d = toDays(date),
        n = julianCycle(d, lw),
        ds = approxTransit(0, lw, n),

        M = solarMeanAnomaly(ds),
        L = eclipticLongitude(M),
        dec = declination(L, 0),

        Jnoon = solarTransitJ(ds, M, L),

        i, len, time, h0, Jset, Jrise;


    var result = {
        solarNoon: fromJulian(Jnoon),
        nadir: fromJulian(Jnoon - 0.5)
    };

    for (i = 0, len = times.length; i < len; i += 1) {
        time = times[i];
        h0 = (time[0] + dh) * rad;

        Jset = getSetJ(h0, lw, phi, dec, n, M, L);
        Jrise = Jnoon - (Jset - Jnoon);

        result[time[1]] = fromJulian(Jrise);
        result[time[2]] = fromJulian(Jset);
    }

// moon calculations, based on http://aa.quae.nl/en/reken/hemelpositie.html formulas

function moonCoords(d) { // geocentric ecliptic coordinates of the moon

    var L = rad * (218.316 + 13.176396 * d), // ecliptic longitude
        M = rad * (134.963 + 13.064993 * d), // mean anomaly

        b  = rad * 5.128 * sin(F),     // latitude

        ra: rightAscension(l, b),
        dec: declination(l, b),

SunCalc.getMoonPosition = function (date, lat, lng) {

    var lw  = rad * -lng,
        phi = rad * lat,
        d   = toDays(date),

        c = moonCoords(d),
        H = siderealTime(d, lw) - c.ra,
        h = altitude(H, phi, c.dec),

    return {
        azimuth: azimuth(H, phi, c.dec),
        altitude: h,
        distance: c.dist,
        parallacticAngle: pa

// calculations for illumination parameters of the moon,
// based on http://idlastro.gsfc.nasa.gov/ftp/pro/astro/mphase.pro formulas and
// Chapter 48 of "Astronomical Algorithms" 2nd edition by Jean Meeus (Willmann-Bell, Richmond) 1998.

SunCalc.getMoonIllumination = function (date) {

    var d = toDays(date || new Date()),
        s = sunCoords(d),
        m = moonCoords(d),

        sdist = 149598000, // distance from Earth to Sun in km

        phi = acos(sin(s.dec) * sin(m.dec) + cos(s.dec) * cos(m.dec) * cos(s.ra - m.ra)),

        angle = atan(cos(s.dec) * sin(s.ra - m.ra), sin(s.dec) * cos(m.dec) -
                cos(s.dec) * sin(m.dec) * cos(s.ra - m.ra));

        phase: 0.5 + 0.5 * inc * (angle < 0 ? -1 : 1) / Math.PI,

    var t = new Date(date);
    if (inUTC) t.setUTCHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    else t.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

    var hc = 0.133 * rad,
        h0 = SunCalc.getMoonPosition(t, lat, lng).altitude - hc,
        h1, h2, rise, set, a, b, xe, ye, d, roots, x1, x2, dx;

    // go in 2-hour chunks, each time seeing if a 3-point quadratic curve crosses zero (which means rise or set)
    for (var i = 1; i <= 24; i += 2) {
        h1 = SunCalc.getMoonPosition(hoursLater(t, i), lat, lng).altitude - hc;
        h2 = SunCalc.getMoonPosition(hoursLater(t, i + 1), lat, lng).altitude - hc;

        a = (h0 + h2) / 2 - h1;
        b = (h2 - h0) / 2;
        xe = -b / (2 * a);
        ye = (a * xe + b) * xe + h1;
        d = b * b - 4 * a * h1;
        roots = 0;

        if (d >= 0) {
            dx = Math.sqrt(d) / (Math.abs(a) * 2);
            x1 = xe - dx;
            x2 = xe + dx;
            if (Math.abs(x1) <= 1) roots++;
            if (Math.abs(x2) <= 1) roots++;
            if (x1 < -1) x1 = x2;

var DAY_CSS="#ilDayView{font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,\"Segoe UI\",sans-serif;color:#234139;max-width:760px;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;margin:0 auto;padding:12px 12px 28px;line-height:1.5;font-size:14px}\n#ilDayView *{box-sizing:border-box}#ilDayView h1,#ilDayView h2,#ilDayView p{margin:0}\n#ilDayView .kd-banner{position:relative;border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;background:#c6e4ed;aspect-ratio:3/1;min-height:80px;box-shadow:0 10px 28px #18372d1d}\n#ilDayView .kd-banner img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;transform:scale(1.012)}\n#ilDayView .kd-banner:after{content:\"\";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 28%,#17352b12 48%,#102d24d8 100%);pointer-events:none}\n#ilDayView .kd-banner-copy{position:absolute;left:15px;right:15px;bottom:14px;z-index:1;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 2px 10px #0003}\n#ilDayView .kd-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:4px 9px;border-radius:999px;background:#ffffff20;border:1px solid #ffffff48;backdrop-filter:blur(3px);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:1.55px;font-weight:780;margin-bottom:7px}\n#ilDayView .kd-place{display:block;font-size:29px;line-height:1.02;font-weight:820;letter-spacing:.15px}\n#ilDayView .kd-tagline{display:block;margin-top:4px;font-size:11px;font-weight:560;letter-spacing:.08px;color:#eef7f4}\n#ilDayView .kd-date{margin:-13px 7px 15px;position:relative;z-index:2;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fffffffd,#fafcfa);border:1px solid #e3ece7;border-radius:19px;padding:17px 15px 15px;box-shadow:0 8px 22px #17362b12}\n#ilDayView .kd-weekday{text-transform:capitalize;color:#21788a;font-size:15px;font-weight:730;letter-spacing:.1px}\n#ilDayView h1{font-size:clamp(25px,6.8vw,34px);line-height:1.18;font-weight:830;letter-spacing:-.72px;margin:2px 0 7px;color:#153b31}\n#ilDayView .kd-date p{font-size:12px;color:#5c7269}#ilDayView .kd-date p span{padding:0 7px;color:#93a49c}\n#ilDayView .kd-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e0e9e4;border-radius:20px;padding:16px;margin:0 0 12px;box-shadow:0 6px 18px #17362b0a}\n#ilDayView .kd-card-title{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-size:16px;font-weight:780;margin-bottom:13px;letter-spacing:-.12px;color:#214239}\n#ilDayView .kd-title-icon{width:29px;height:29px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:0 0 29px;border-radius:10px;background:#eef5f1;color:#276958;font-size:16px;font-weight:700}\n#ilDayView .kd-sun{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fffaed,#fff 58%);border-color:#eadfbd}\n#ilDayView .kd-sun .kd-title-icon{background:#fff0bd;color:#886410}\n#ilDayView .kd-metrics{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}\n#ilDayView .kd-metric{border:1px solid #ece5d3;border-radius:14px;padding:10px 11px;background:#fffffff0;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 #fff;min-height:84px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center}\n#ilDayView .kd-metric-top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:11px;color:#7b6e4f;line-height:1.25}\n#ilDayView .kd-metric-ico{font-size:16px;line-height:1}\n#ilDayView .kd-metric strong{display:block;font-size:25px;line-height:1.15;font-weight:790;letter-spacing:-.35px;color:#203f35;margin-top:4px}\n#ilDayView .kd-length{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;padding:15px 2px 3px}#ilDayView .kd-length span{color:#655f4e}#ilDayView .kd-length strong{font-size:20px;color:#263f37}\n#ilDayView .kd-delta{color:#73694e;font-size:12px}\n#ilDayView .kd-axis{padding:27px 5px 7px}\n#ilDayView .kd-axis-line{height:8px;border-radius:999px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#b6d2dc,#ead18a 12%,#f2bd42 50%,#ead18a 88%,#b6d2dc);position:relative;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 2px #00000014}\n#ilDayView .kd-axis-line i{position:absolute;width:2px;height:12px;top:-2px;background:#8b8265;border-radius:3px;opacity:.8}\n#ilDayView .kd-now{position:absolute;width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;background:#176d63;border:3px solid #fff;top:-4px;transform:translateX(-50%);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #176d6320}\n#ilDayView .kd-now-label{position:absolute;top:-29px;transform:translateX(-50%);font-size:9px;line-height:1;padding:5px .kd-axis-labels{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:9px;color:#756d58;margin-top:8px}\n#ilDayView .kd-note{font-size:11px;color:#63776e;line-height:1.52;margin-top:6px}\n#ilDayView .kd-local{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(140deg,#e8f5ee,#fbfdfb);border-color:#cbe3d5}\n#ilDayView .kd-local .kd-title-icon{background:#ddefe4;color:#226748}\n#ilDayView .kd-local-content{position:relative;z-index:1;padding-right:6%}\n#ilDayView .kd-local-text{font-size:16px;font-weight:575;line-height:1.58;color:#234a3c}\n#ilDayView .kd-local-mark{position:absolute;right:-29px;bottom:-53px;width:245px;height:165px;opacity:.105;pointer-events:none}\n#ilDayView .kd-local-mark .kd-names{font-size:17px;font-weight:700;margin:3px 0 13px;color:#243f37}\n#ilDayView .kd-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:9px 0;border-top:1px solid #edf1ee}#ilDayView .kd-row b{color:#2e4b42}\n#ilDayView .kd-trade .kd-title-icon{background:#eaf4f3;color:#2c6f6c}\n#ilDayView .kd-status{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;font-size:14px;font-weight:780;margin-bottom:9px;padding:7px 11px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid transparent}\n#ilDayView .kd-pill-work{background:#e9f6f2;color:#14695f;border-color:#d4ebe4}\n#ilDayView .kd-pill-shop{background:#eaf6ec;color:#286a45;border-color:#d7eadb}\n#ilDayView .kd-pill-closed{background:#f1f4f3;color:#596f67;border-color:#e2e8e5}\n#ilDayView .kd-next{background:#f0f6f5;border-radius:13px;padding:11px 12px;margin-top:12px;border:1px solid #e3eeea}#ilDayView .kd-next span,#ilDayView .kd-next b{display:block}#ilDayView .kd-next span{font-size:11px;color:#62766e}#ilDayView .kd-next b{font-size:15px;margin-top:3px;color:#294d42}\n#ilDayView .kd-events .kd-title-icon{background:#eef5ef;color:#497153}#ilDayView .kd-unusual .kd-title-icon{background:#f4f0f8;color:#6d5684}\n#ilDayView .kd-item{line-height:1.52}#ilDayView .kd-item+.kd-item{border-top:1px solid #edf1ee;margin-top:9px;padding-top:9px}\n#ilDayView .kd-proverb{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fffdf7,#fff9e9);border-color:#ece1bd;position:relative;overflow:hidden}\n#ilDayView .kd-proverb .kd-title-icon{background:#f7edcb;color:#8d7130}\n#ilDayView .kd-proverb blockquote{font-size:16px;font-style:italic;margin:0;padding:3px 4px 3px 15px;border-left:3px solid #d8c78b;position:relative;line-height:1.62;color:#4a4434}\n#ilDayView .kd-proverb blockquote:before{content:\"„\";position:absolute;left:-2px;top:-10px;font-size:36px;line-height:1;color:#d7c47d;opacity:.72}\n#ilDayView .kd-moon-card{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#f3f8fc,#fff 62%);border-color:#d8e6f0}\n#ilDayView .kd-moon-card .kd-title-icon{background:#e7f0f7;color:#506d86}\n#ilDayView .kd-moon{display:flex;gap:15px;align-items:center}#ilDayView .kd-moon>span{font-size:44px;line-height:1.25;filter:saturate(.88)}#ilDayView .kd-moon b{font-size:16px;color:#304c61}#ilDayView .kd-moon p{color:#647783;margin-top:2px}\n#ilDayView .kd-upcoming-card .kd-title-icon{background:#e8f4ee;color:#266851}\n#ilDayView .kd-upcoming{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:10px 0;border-top:1px solid #edf1ee}#ilDayView .kd-upcoming:first-of-type{border-top:0;padding-top:0}#ilDayView .kd-upcoming b{display:block;color:#28483e}#ilDayView .kd-upcoming 9px;font-size:11px;color:#286a52;font-weight:760}#ilDayView .kd-tomorrow{background:#dff1e8;color:#1f6549;border-color:#cce7da}\n#ilDayView .kd-sources{font-size:11px;color:#687e72;padding:3px 5px 1px}#ilDayView .kd-sources summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:680}#ilDayView .kd-sources p{margin-top:9px}\n#ilDayBottom{position:fixed;z-index:99985;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));padding:5px 4px calc(5px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));background:#fffffff6;border-top:1px solid #d9e8e2;box-shadow:0 -3px 14px #17362b0b;font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,\"Segoe UI\",sans-serif;backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}\n#ilDayBottom button{min-height:53px;background:transparent;border:0;border-radius:12px;color:#627b71;padding:3px 1px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:3px}#ilDayBottom button b{font-size:10px;line-height:1.25;white-space:nowrap;font-weight:680}.kd-nav-icon{width:22px;height:22px;display:block}.kd-nav-icon .kd-active{color:#176d63;background:#e8f4ee}\n.kd-with-bottom #iaP{padding-bottom:calc(72px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}.kd-with-bottom body{padding-bottom:calc(72px + small{display:block;font-size:12px}#kdRetry{margin-top:9px;padding:8px;border:0;border-radius:9px;color:#246b65;background:#fff}\nbody.senior #ilDayView{font-size:17px}body.senior #ilDayView .kd-card-title{font-size:20px}body.senior #ilDayView .kd-note{font-size:13px}body.senior #ilDayBottom button .kd-banner{max-height:210px}#ilDayBottom button b{font-size:12px}}\n";
